OUTPUT CONTRACT per assigned page:
PAGE: <slug>
RATING: <A|B|C|D|F> — one-line justification
INTENT: <primary intent> — <aligned|partial|mismatched> + why (<=15 words)
ISSUES: 3-6 bullets, each naming exact section/heading/quote
FACTS: 3-6 lines: "<claim>" — CONFIRMED/REFUTED/UNVERIFIED — <evidence URL / what contradicts>

FIXES: specific (remove X / rewrite Y / verify Z against <source> / expand with <specific> / consolidate into <slug> / redirect) — executable without re-reading
SEO: title/meta/headings/links/schema opportunities, specific
